title: Fix sizes=auto grammar, parsing, and omitted source sizes fallback
body: Fix `sizes=auto` grammar, parsing, and omitted `source` `sizes` fallback Update the `valid source size list` grammar so `auto` is only allowed alone or as the first comma-separated entry, disallowing ` auto` in both the grammar and `parse a sizes attribute`. Change `parse a sizes attribute` (and `create a source set`) to accept a string or null instead of an element. In `update the source set`, pass `"auto"` when a `source` element omits its `sizes` attribute and the following `img` element `allows auto-sizes`, while preserving `100vw` fallback when `sizes=""` is explicitly empty. In `parse a sizes attribute`, trim leading as well as trailing ``s from each entry, match a single `` whose value is an ASCII case-insensitive match for `"auto"` before parsing a ``, and `continue` to subsequent entries when `auto` cannot be resolved (either because `img` is null or does not `allow auto-sizes`, or because `img` is not `being rendered` and has no `last auto-sizes width`). Tests: https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/64904. --- - [x] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): * Chromium (already implements) * Gecko (partially implements; `source` `sizes` fallback pending) * WebKit (partially implements; `source` `sizes` fallback pending) - [x] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/64904 - [x] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed: * Chromium: already matches * Gecko: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2091392 * WebKit: https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=330919 * Deno (only for timers, structured clone, base64 utils, channel messaging, module resolution, web workers, and web storage): N/A * Node.js (only for timers, structured clone, base64 utils, channel messaging, and module resolution): N/A - [x] Corresponding [HTML AAM](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/) & [ARIA in HTML](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/) issues & PRs: N/A - [x] [MDN issue](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) is filed: N/A - [x] The top of this comment includes a [clear commit message](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/COMMITTING.md) to use.
